# Users triggers

## First words

Runs when a viewer writes in chat for the first time of the stream. Great for a welcome message. It starts over each time you go live, or when you reset it.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only react to chat on this site. All means every site you are connected to. Options: All, Twitch, Rumble, YouTube, Kick, Streamlabs, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, DonorDrive, TreatStream, Pally.gg, StreamLoots, Crowd Control, Ko-fi, Patreon, Shopify, Fourthwall, Throne. Starts as: `All`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The viewer's name |
| `%message%` | What they wrote |
| `%platform%` | The site they wrote on, like twitch |
| `%userId%` | Their id on that site |
| `%isNewUser%` | True if this is the first time Cuebot has ever seen them |
| `%messageCount%` | How many messages Cuebot has seen from them in total |

<small>Type id: `users.firstWords`</small>

## Present viewers

Runs every few minutes with the viewers who chatted recently. Good for giving points to everyone who is around. Set how often on the Users & Groups page.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Platform** | Only react to viewers on this site. All means every site you are connected to. Options: All, Twitch, Rumble, YouTube, Kick, Streamlabs, StreamElements, TipeeeStream, DonorDrive, TreatStream, Pally.gg, StreamLoots, Crowd Control, Ko-fi, Patreon, Shopify, Fourthwall, Throne. Starts as: `All`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%platform%` | The site these viewers are on |
| `%count%` | How many viewers are present |
| `%userNames%` | Their names in one line, separated by commas |
| `%userIds%` | Their ids in one line, separated by commas |
| `%isLive%` | Whether the stream is live, when the site tells Cuebot |

<small>Type id: `users.presentViewers`</small>
